event_experiment.description:
Complete Plot 1 water event, conservative dry handoff, and explicit restart.

Backends (CW-C1): `backend='numpy'` runs the array or numba hydraulics on the host (unchanged default);
`backend='cupy'` runs ONLY the explicit CUDA hydrology (`implementation='cuda'`, bisection or Newton) with the
whole small case prepared in CuPy after the CW-A1 device memory preflight, the caller-owned `CudaHydraulics`
lifecycle handed to the solver, checkpoints written through the host bundle format and resumed in the same
backend only. Every other pairing is refused before the case is touched; there is no fallback in either direction.
Reporting converts device results with MAPLE's counted host helpers; the loop timing is synchronized before it is
read. The optional `allow_maple_source_change` flag is the existing case-verification option (an explicitly
recorded isolated MAPLE source difference), never a mutation of the original inputs.

windowed_experiment.description:
Explicit conservative water events on actual MAPLE resident-window beds.

Shares the complete-event solver, wet laws, rainfall factories, checkpoints
and accounting with the dense runner. Deep voxels stay in an immutable MAPLE
host store; final outputs and checkpoints contain resident arrays and version
references. This is not the unlimited-supply MAHLERAN legacy replay.

legacy_experiment.description: MAPLE-SYRUP default run: Python/Numba replay of the MAHLERAN LEGACY sediment transport on frozen Plot1 terrain (dt = 1 s, no splash, fixed routing). SYRUP hydrology + wet MAHLERAN laws + source-based flow_distrib deposition and the legacy Crank-Nicolson pool with explicit clipping-source accounting. Scientific status: fixed composition, UNLIMITED supply, explicit clipping source, NO evolving MAPLE bed. It is NOT a conservative complete-event, restart or wind-handoff model and its legacy behaviour is not MAPLE authority. The conservative multi-bin characteristic model is kept and selected explicitly with --transport-scheme characteristic (or upwind); multi-bin convergence/performance work is deferred (Phase 7g).

benchmark_experiment_characteristic.description:
MAPLE-SYRUP matched fixed-terrain wet benchmark of Plot 1.

DEFAULT (--transport-scheme legacy): Python/Numba replay of the MAHLERAN legacy sediment transport (dt = 1 s, frozen terrain, no splash). Fixed composition, UNLIMITED supply, explicit clipping source, NO evolving MAPLE bed; not a conservative complete-event, restart or wind-handoff model. Run it with only --case-dir/--output-dir (see `python -m maple_syrup.legacy_experiment --help`); controls it cannot honour (dt != 1, --backend cupy, --phase-bins, Courant/substep options) are refused, not ignored.

EXPLICIT (--transport-scheme characteristic | upwind): the conservative model with actual MAPLE sediment exchange and reference applied rainfall (frozen hydraulic geometry, deterministic conductivity). Multi-bin characteristic convergence/performance is deferred (Phase 7g). No completion, dry reset, restart, wind or GPU. The options below apply to this model and --applied-rainfall is required for it.
